stem:
Naveen sprinkles a few drops of water on a hot dosa tawa. The drops disappear quickly.

What has the liquid water become?

options.text: Invisible water vapour in the air.
Ordinary air, so the water has changed into oxygen and nitrogen.
Liquid water again, because evaporation turns vapour into liquid.
Water vapour only if the water first boiled with big bubbles; otherwise it vanished into nothing.

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation turns liquid water into water vapour, which can be invisible. It does not become air; the process is not vapour-to-liquid; boiling is not required for evaporation.
